title: Quiet Is Not the Same as Unconfident
summary: Give a quiet teenager room to answer without turning a pause into a label.
release_move: Let the teenager answer in their own time and interpret their own experience before offering a solution.

core_belief_shift.from: A quiet teenager must be unconfident or socially behind.
core_belief_shift.to: A pause is information to notice before deciding what support, if any, is useful.

book_relevance.reason: This guide is about avoiding a premature label; a Playbook is not the most useful next tool at this moment.
